name: Giovanni Ferrero

controls.name: Ferrero Group (parent: Ferrero International S.A., Luxembourg; Italian holding Ferrero S.p.A., Alba)
controls.role: Executive Chairman (CEO until 2017); majority owner. FY2024/25 (to Aug 31, 2025) turnover EUR19.3bn (+4.6%), 48,697 employees, 36 plants, ~EUR1.1bn capex

controls.name: WK Kellogg Co (Corn Flakes, Froot Loops, Rice Krispies in North America)
controls.role: Wholly owned indirect subsidiary of Ferrero International S.A. since Sept 26, 2025

controls.name: Ferrara Candy Company (Chicago; Butterfinger, Crunch, Nerds, Jelly Belly, Trolli, SweeTARTS etc.)
controls.role: Ferrero-affiliated company; bought Dec 2017 via Pontiac Holdco Inc., US subsidiary of the Ferrero family's Belgian holding CTH Invest

controls.name: Wells Enterprises (Blue Bunny, Halo Top, Bomb Pop ice cream)
controls.role: Acquired by Ferrero Group (announced Dec 7, 2022; completed 2023)

controls.name: Other Ferrero-affiliated companies: Nonni's, Fox's & Burton's Biscuits, Fine Biscuits Company, Michel et Augustin; brands incl. Keebler, Famous Amos, Fannie May, Thorntons
controls.role: Family-controlled Ferrero affiliates (per Ferrero Sept 2025 release)

vehicles.name: Ferrero International S.A.
vehicles.notes: Luxembourg public limited company; group parent and reporting entity; acquirer of WK Kellogg. No EDGAR entity CIK found.

vehicles.name: CTH Invest S.A.
vehicles.notes: Belgian holding company (Brussels region, founded Aug 3, 2016, capital ~EUR4.75bn); Giovanni Ferrero is a director. Described by Italian press as a 'parallel Ferrero' holding the affiliated businesses (e.g. Fine Biscuits Company; via FFH Holding/Pontiac Holdco, Ferrara).

vehicles.name: FFH Holding S.A.
vehicles.notes: Belgian holding (founded Oct 18, 2017, capital ~EUR3.3bn) used for acquisitions outside Europe; parent of Pontiac Holdco Inc. (US)

privateDeals.what: Ferrero International acquired WK Kellogg Co for $23.00/share cash (~$1.99bn equity; ~$3.1bn per Forbes); agreed July 10, 2025, closed Sept 26, 2025; bridge financing from HSBC
Ferrara's European holding completed purchase of CPK Group (Carambar, Lutti, Krema, Poulain, Terry's) from Eurazeo, ~EUR240m proceeds to Eurazeo
Ferrero announced acquisition of breakfast/granola brand Purely Elizabeth for a reported $850m (Inc. report)
Power Crunch (high-protein bars) acquired during FY2024/25

policy.what: European Commission unannounced antitrust inspections of Ferrero (April 2026) in two EU member states over possible market segmentation / restrictions on cross-border trade and multi-country purchases (Art. 101/102 TFEU); inspections do not imply guilt
2022 Kinder Surprise salmonella outbreak investigated by EFSA/ECDC, linked to Ferrero's Arlon (Belgium) plant (as of 2022)

giving.name: Fondazione Piera, Pietro e Giovanni Ferrero (Ferrero Foundation, Alba; est. 1983, recognized 1991; culture and support for retired long-serving employees)

watch.what: EU Commission antitrust probe into Ferrero's cross-border trade restrictions - possible formal proceedings
Closing of Purely Elizabeth acquisition (announced Aug 2026)
Integration of WK Kellogg Co under Ferrero North America; FY2025/26 (year ended Aug 31, 2026) results - last year's were published Feb 2026
